name: shopify-dev-theme
description: 分层源码 + 打包产物的 Shopify OS 2.0 主题工程

scripts.dev: npm run build:liquid && npx --yes concurrently -k -n liquid,vite,shopify -c blue,magenta,green "npm run watch:liquid" "npm run dev:vite" "npm run dev:shopify"
scripts.build: npm run build:liquid && npm run build:vite
scripts.push: npm run build && node scripts/run-with-proxy.mjs npx --yes @shopify/cli theme push --path theme --store cyan-dev-store1.myshopify.com
scripts.pull: node scripts/run-with-proxy.mjs npx --yes @shopify/cli theme pull --path theme --store cyan-dev-store1.myshopify.com
scripts.dev:shopify: node scripts/run-with-proxy.mjs npx --yes @shopify/cli theme dev --path theme --store cyan-dev-store1.myshopify.com
